stores.note: Large multi-brand catalog, mostly designer and Japanese labels (Dries Van Noten, Auralee, Lemaire, Our Legacy, orSlow, SMOCK, Studio Nicholson). A lot of it is over $500 or in women's cuts. All 4 picks checked via /products/<handle>.js with several sizes available.
stores.vibe: Silver Lake boutique mixing quiet designer and Japanese labels (Auralee, Lemaire, Our Legacy, orSlow) with its own LA-made house line SMOCK. The look is minimal and texture-driven, with an artsy West Coast edge.

stores.note: USD prices are what the site itself shows on the US storefront (Shopify.currency active USD, rate 1.162749 from EUR base). The /products/<handle>.js endpoint without ?currency=USD returns EUR, so the EUR base price is in price_note. Product pages list composition and measurements, but say little about fit or fabric weight. AW26 range goes well beyond shirts: corduroy and herringbone jackets, wool trousers, wool/jacquard overshirts.
stores.vibe: Portuguese-made shirting brand known for brushed flannels, jacquards and seersucker. It now also offers a full tailoring-casual range of corduroy and herringbone jackets, wool trousers and wool overshirts at approachable prices.
